name: showtime
description: A local video studio for your coding agent. Describe a video. Your agent directs. Your machine renders. Motion graphics rendered frame-exactly, voice-over, music and sound design, footage editing from transcripts, captions and platform-ready exports. Everything runs on your machine.

voice.title: Default narration voice
voice.description: Voice used when a request names none, e.g. af_heart (warm, US English), am_michael, bf_emma (British), ef_dora (Spanish). List them with `showtime voice list`. A voice in another language than the video's is skipped for that video.

language.title: Default narration language
language.description: Language for narration when a request names none: en, en-gb, es, fr, it, pt-br, hi, ja or zh.

open_browser.title: Open review boards in the browser
open_browser.description: When on, `showtime studio open` also opens the board in your default browser (otherwise it prints the link).

max_workers.title: CPU limit (0 = automatic)
max_workers.description: Most parallel render browsers and CPU threads showtime may use. 0 lets showtime decide; set 1 or 2 to keep the machine responsive while it renders.

sound.title: Sound when a long job finishes
sound.description: When on, a short showtime sound plays after a render, export or other command that ran over 20 seconds finishes, in a terminal you run showtime from yourself (never in Claude's tool calls, pipes, CI or with NO_COLOR). Same as SHOWTIME_SOUND=1.

mode.title: Review mode (quality or lean)
mode.description: quality (used when this is empty): every finished video gets the full review, with looks, qa and a critic round before delivery. lean: a cheaper draft pass with one look per stage and no critic round unless the video is publish-bound or you ask. Leave empty to use `showtime config mode` (quality unless set there). SHOWTIME_MODE overrides it.

home.title: showtime folder (advanced)
home.description: Where showtime keeps its tools, models and caches (several GB). Leave empty for ~/.showtime. After changing it, run `showtime setup` once.
